# dsh-tps

A live **tokens-per-second** card for the current DeepSeek Harness session. It
docks into the left s

idebar, or floats as a draggable card — switch with the
toggle at the card's top-right corner.
| Average mode | Floating card |
## What it shows

- **Live t/s** — throughput of the streaming assistant output, computed from real
`agent/assistant-s

tream` deltas (a sliding window, with a denominator floor so
bursty chunks cannot spike the number).

- **Average t/s** — session-wide average since the first token; toggle 实时 /
平均 (live / average) wit

h the segmented control in the card header.
- **Buffered-stream fallback** — some providers (e.g. th

e UM reverse proxy) deliver
the whole reply in one burst, so no live decode window exists. The live

slot then
shows the last step's **step-wide average** (including first-token wait), marked
“整步计速” in

the tooltip, instead of sitting at 0.0.
- **Sparkline** — the last 40 samples, drawn with the card'

s own accent colour.
- **Current task name** — left-aligned above the speed, following the card's
se

lected session and remaining visible when collapsed. Long names use an
ellipsis with the full name o

n hover; untitled sessions show their short ID.
- **Session list** — every session with a reading, t

itled and followed by the
workspace it lives in, e.g. `dsh-tps (dsh-tps)`. Click a row to switch the

card
to that session; the click does not touch your current page.
## Dock left or float
The two buttons at the card's top-right choose the placement:

- **左侧 (left)** — dock into the sidebar footer slot. The card follows the
sidebar: if the slot disap

pears (narrow window, collapsed sidebar), it falls
back to the floating position instead of vanishin

g.
- **悬浮 (float)** — stay pinned as a floating card at the bottom-right corner.

The choice is remembered in `localStorage`, as are the floating position, the
collapsed state and th
e mode (live/average).
## Dragging

In floating mode the **whole card** is a drag handle — header, number, sparkline,
empty space. Only

the buttons, the segmented controls and the session rows opt
out, because those are click targets. D

rags are tracked on `document`, so the
card keeps following the pointer even when it leaves the card

, and a drag never
fires the click that would toggle the card.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Then restart the harness service (the card appears in the sidebar once the plugin
is loaded). No bui
ld step, no dependencies.
## How it works

- `lib/tracker.js` keeps a per-session sliding window fed by
`agent/assistant-stream` deltas and `se

ssion/event` (turn boundaries, cache-hit
usage totals).
- `lib/index.js` subscribes to those events,

exposes
`GET /dsh-tps/state.json` and `GET /dsh-tps/widget.js`, and injects the card
through **both

** supported paths: the structured `webserver/index-inject` table
(used by the Electron desktop shel

l) and `ctx.webServer.tapIndex()` (used when
the Host renders `index.html` itself, e.g. `dsh web`).

- `lib/widget.js` is served from disk on every request, so editing it and
reloading the page is enou

gh — no restart. A `⟳` hint appears when the page is
still running an older copy of the widget than

A `⟳` hint appears when the page is
still running an older copy of the widget than the one on disk.

Chunks arriving in the same millisecond share one sample, retaining their full
token count during bu

rsts. The event stream also sweeps expired trackers at most
once a minute, even without an open widg

et. State and update-check requests time
out after 5 seconds, including response-body reads; polling

then retries normally
and slows to a 5-second interval after three consecutive failures.
## Tests
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Covers the window denominator floor, idle decay, in-flight step readings,
block-end fallback, cache-

hit accounting, burst aggregation and tracker cleanup.
Widget tests run the injected script with a l

ightweight DOM and a virtual clock
to verify timeout recovery, failure backoff, visibility changes a

nd update checks.
No real waiting, network or external dependencies are needed.
